topic: Security lessons for NFTs, token-bound accounts, launchpads and on-chain apps (2024-2026)

findings.claim: ERC-6551 (still under review) leaves fraud prevention (owner empties account before sale) and ownership cycles (depth>1) out of scope; it suggests state snapshots on orders and account-level locks.
findings.relevance: Our _update epoch-roll plus Reach seal/Grip no-outbound are the application-level answers the EIP asks for.

findings.claim: tokenbound AccountV3 only guards depth-1 cycles (msg.sender == tokenContract && tokenId == _tokenId) and walks nested owners with no explicit depth limit.
findings.relevance: Add depth-2 check and a bounded (8-hop) owner walk; accountOf sits on eight settlement paths.

findings.claim: ERC-1271 signatures were replayable across smart accounts owned by one EOA (Permit2 omits owner); fixed industry-wide by defensive rehashing, standardised as ERC-7739 (magic 0x77390001, contentsName sanitisation).
findings.relevance: Bound-account isValidSignature must implement ERC-7739; session keys never satisfy 1271.

findings.claim: Alchemy disclosed (2024-03-29) the ERC-1271 replay affecting LightAccount, Kernel, Biconomy, Soul, Ambire, OKX and Permit2/CoW flows.
findings.relevance: Concrete list of what breaks without domain-bound rehashing.

findings.claim: Trail of Bits (2026-03-11) lists six ERC-4337 account mistakes: unprotected execute, signature not binding gas fields, stateful validation, 1271 without domain, reverts in postOp don't refund, 7702 init races.
findings.relevance: Checklist for AgentAccount's 4337 path; question whether 4337 is needed at all.

findings.claim: Cork Protocol lost 3,761 wstETH (~$11-12M) on 2025-05-28: hook beforeSwap accepted unvalidated hookData; attacker spoofed a PoolManager.unlock context; Cork ran a periphery one security commit behind.
findings.relevance: All hook callbacks onlyPoolManager; hookData untrusted; pin and track periphery versions.

findings.claim: Bunni v2 lost $8.4M on 2025-09-02 (Ethereum + Unichain) from a withdraw rounding direction error exploited via flash loan and 44 small withdrawals, despite prior audits.
findings.relevance: Rounding direction must be named per call site and fuzzed at extreme balances.

findings.claim: Trail of Bits (2026-07-30) names seven v4 hook vulnerability classes and eight defences (BaseHook/SafeCallback gating, PoolKey allowlists, delta segregation, permission-bit verification, PoolId-keyed temp state).
findings.relevance: Direct checklist for MASTER/GARDEN custom-hook launches.

findings.claim: Balancer v2 lost $125-128M on 2025-11-03 because _upscale only rounded down while _swapGivenOut needed round-up; attacker positioned balances at 9 and swapped 8 in 65+ micro-swaps inside one batchSwap; bug dated from 2021.
findings.relevance: Rounding inconsistency between two functions, not one wrong direction, is the failure mode.

findings.claim: SIR Trading lost its entire $355k TVL on 2025-03-30: transient slot 1 reused for pool-address check and mint amount; attacker mined a vanity address equal to the amount.
findings.relevance: ANIMA uses transient storage in 16 contracts; one hashed slot per purpose, cleared on exit.

findings.claim: EIP-1153 security considerations: transient storage is not discarded on return or revert; only leave non-zero slots when a later call in the same tx should read them.
findings.relevance: Reentrancy guards in tstore must clear on every exit path.

findings.claim: KelpDAO rsETH lost $292M on 2026-04-18 because its OFTAdapter was 1-of-1 DVN; compromise of that single DVN's signing infrastructure authenticated arbitrary messages.
findings.relevance: ParleyPort/OmniAgent config must be >=2-of-N required DVNs, pinned libraries, recorded in deployments.

findings.claim: LayerZero docs: UlnConfig(confirmations, requiredDVNCount, optionalDVNCount, optionalDVNThreshold, requiredDVNs, optionalDVNs); defaults are mutable and may rotate without the OApp's involvement; send config on A must match receive config on B; production should use multiple independent required DVNs.
findings.relevance: Pin send/receive libraries and set explicit UlnConfig on both sides at deploy; test getAppUlnConfig.

findings.claim: Press reports say 47% of LayerZero OApps ran 1-of-1 DVN configs after the Kelp hack and that Kelp had downgraded from 2-of-2; LayerZero is moving defaults to 5/5 (min 3/3).
findings.relevance: Policy context only; figures not confirmed against a primary source.

findings.claim: Four.meme (Feb 2025): migration used createAndInitializePoolIfNecessary with amount0Min=amount1Min=0; attacker pre-initialised the v3 pool at ~3.7e14x price and drained 23.4 WBNB.
findings.relevance: Graduation must verify or refuse a pre-existing pool and pass real amountMins.

findings.claim: Four.meme (2025-03-17/18): buyTokenAMAP delivered pre-launch tokens to the predicted, not-yet-created PancakeSwap pair, bypassing MODE_TRANSFER_RESTRICTED; attacker sandwiched migration with pre-added LP (~$120-130k).
findings.relevance: Pre-launch tokens must be non-transferable by every path; refuse predicted pool recipients.

findings.claim: pump.fun (2024-05-16): a former employee with the withdraw authority used flash loans to push curves to 100% and extract ~12,300 SOL (~$1.9M) of $45M curve liquidity.
findings.relevance: No privileged withdraw authority on curve funds; graduation permissionless.

findings.claim: HAWK (2024-12-04): ~96% of supply acquired by sniper/insider wallets in the first seconds of a bonding-curve launch; ~$3.3M extracted; market cap ~$491M to ~$25M in ~20 minutes (Bubblemaps attribution).
findings.relevance: Snipe tax with no exemptions and early per-address caps.

findings.claim: Robinhood Chain / Pons (Sept 2026): >=$18.43M extracted across 53 launches by whitelisting 15-25 wallets exempt from the 99% snipe tax and buying the whole curve in one tx.
findings.relevance: Creator-controlled tax exemptions are a rug primitive; domain is not coindesk.com so treat figures as unverified.

findings.claim: Code4rena Revert Lend (March 2024): a reverting onERC721Received made liquidation impossible (High); fix is transferFrom or pull-based claims.
findings.relevance: Protocol-driven NFT pushes in escrow/market/router must not use safeTransferFrom.

findings.claim: ERC-7201 slot formula keccak256(abi.encode(uint256(keccak256(id)) - 1)) & ~0xff with @custom:storage-location; developer responsible for enforcement.
findings.relevance: Diamond facets must never declare plain state; keep the slots-0-2-empty test.

findings.claim: ERC-5219 (Final) security considerations cover only ordinary URL-access risks (e.g. 3XX redirects); content safety is the implementer's job.
findings.relevance: Premises.request output needs CSP and escaping; the standard gives none.

findings.claim: NFT marketplace XSS vectors: SVG with embedded <script>, javascript: URLs in prefixed social-link fields, unsanitised description/profile fields.
findings.relevance: All chain/user strings through Web.esc/jsonEsc and textContent; validate links as https with host allowlist.

findings.claim: OpenSea renders animation_url HTML in a sandboxed iframe; CSP script-src 'self' does not permit data: or srcdoc scripts.
findings.relevance: A data: tokenURI page has an opaque origin and no wallet; wallet-connected site must come from the web3:// surface or a gateway origin.

findings.claim: OpenZeppelin's 2025 rewind: Bybit $1.4B via compromised Safe UI; EIP-7702 broke tx.origin/EOA-only checks (POT $85k, Gana $3.1M); CPIMP proxy-initialisation campaign; ERC-6492 bypass via precompile 0x04; BaseCustomAccounting hook reinit flaw.
findings.relevance: No tx.origin/extcodesize gates; no initializers; immutable on-chain UI is a strength only with CSP and escaping.

findings.claim: Sherlock Symbiotic Relay (June 2025): a deliberately chain-agnostic EIP-712 domain allowed validator-set commits to be replayed across chains.
findings.relevance: Never omit chainId/verifyingContract from a domain, even for 'cross-chain' objects.

findings.claim: Permit2 exposes invalidateNonces (<= 2^16 per call) and lockdown batch revocation; PR #171 extends to ERC-721 operators.
findings.relevance: ANIMA's epoch-keyed approval store is the O(1) equivalent; keep and extend to all delegated authority.

findings.claim: EIP-7702 batch-signature phishing drained $150k (2025-05-24), ~$350k (Aug 2025) and $1.54M (late Aug 2025) in single-signature atomic batches; Wintermute reported >97% of early delegations were sweepers.
findings.relevance: Provide a one-call panic() that bumps all epochs and seals the Reach.

findings.claim: ERC-4626 first-depositor inflation still drains protocols (Venus on ZKsync, 86.72 WETH, Feb 2025); OZ virtual shares make it ~1000x harder.
findings.relevance: Any share-based vault/bond accounting needs virtual or dead shares.

findings.claim: _safeMint reentrancy via onERC721Received let attackers exceed per-wallet mint limits (HypeBears; Code4rena NextGen #1154).
findings.relevance: Update counters before _safeMint and use nonReentrant on mint.

findings.claim: Base's protocol minimum gas price (from Dec 2025) cut spam's share of gas from ~26% to <9%; Monad charges by gas limit; Farcaster rents storage units (~$7/unit/year) to bound spam.
findings.relevance: Messaging price must be set by the protocol (body cap, cooldown, priced DMs, spam bond), not left to chain fees.

recommendations.recommendation: Make a custody epoch the root of all delegated authority: _update bumps custodyEpoch[id] and approvalEpoch[seller], clearing operators, session grants, lease, guardian, launch roles and room moderator rights in one transfer.
recommendations.rationale: ERC-6551 fraud section; ANIMA invariant 1; MASTER custody epochs. Authority that outlives the sale is the #1 TBA failure.

recommendations.recommendation: Keep the Grip as a receive-only account with no outbound function, and a test that no selector can move an asset.
recommendations.rationale: IPSEITY's strongest guarantee; absence of a spend path is the only vault guarantee that cannot be bypassed by a bug.

recommendations.recommendation: Implement ERC-7739 in the bound account's isValidSignature; session keys never satisfy ERC-1271; all signed objects are EIP-712 with chainId, verifyingContract, nonce, tokenId and epoch.
recommendations.rationale: ERC-1271 cross-account replay (Alchemy 2024), Symbiotic cross-chain replay (2025), ToB mistake #4.

recommendations.recommendation: Launchpad graduation: permissionless, no withdraw authority, verify-or-refuse any pre-existing pool, real amountMins, LP minted atomically; pre-launch tokens non-transferable by every path including permit and buy-for helpers; refuse predicted pool recipients.
recommendations.rationale: pump.fun insider (2024), Four.meme twice (Feb/Mar 2025).

recommendations.recommendation: Snipe tax with a public immutable decay schedule and no exemption list; first-N-blocks per-address caps; creator allocation only through vesting locks.
recommendations.rationale: HAWK (96% sniped), Pons exemption abuse (2026).

recommendations.recommendation: Every v4 hook callback onlyPoolManager; beforeInitialize allow-lists our PoolKeys; hookData untrusted; no non-essential code on withdraw paths; permission bits asserted in tests; fuzz nested callbacks and malicious tokens.
recommendations.rationale: Cork ($11-12M), Bunni ($8.4M), Trail of Bits 2026-07-30 classes.

recommendations.recommendation: Rounding: expose only mulDivUp/mulDivDown, name the direction at each call site, fuzz round-trip-never-profits at 0/1/2/9/2^64/2^128 wei across curve, pool and vault share math; virtual shares on any share accounting.
recommendations.rationale: Balancer v2 ($128M) was an inconsistency between two functions; ERC-4626 inflation persists.

recommendations.recommendation: Transient storage: one hashed slot per purpose, never small integers, cleared on every exit path; a test enumerates all T_* constants, asserts uniqueness and zero after each external call.
recommendations.rationale: SIR Trading slot collision; ANIMA uses tstore in 16 contracts.

recommendations.recommendation: LayerZero: >=2-of-N required DVNs from independent operators, send/receive libraries pinned, config symmetric on both sides, set at construction or by a timelocked owner that is then renounced; full UlnConfig in deployment records and diffed in CI.
recommendations.rationale: KelpDAO $292M via 1-of-1; LayerZero docs warn defaults rotate silently.

recommendations.recommendation: Never gate on tx.origin or extcodesize==0; no initializers, proxies or diamondCut; constructor-wired, immutable deployments.
recommendations.rationale: EIP-7702 broke EOA checks (POT, Gana); CPIMP proxy-init campaign; three repos already immutable.

recommendations.recommendation: Website: every chain/user string through Web.esc/jsonEsc, textContent only in the browser, CSP meta in every page, artwork routes served by the router not pages; wallet verification is a view and every privileged action is re-authorised on chain via mayActAs; SIWE with nonce/domain/chainId/expiry and ERC-1271/7739 for bound accounts.
recommendations.rationale: Marketplace XSS class; ERC-5219 gives no content-safety guidance; Bybit shows the UI as boundary.

recommendations.recommendation: Protocol-driven NFT transfers use transferFrom or pull-based claims; external calls gas-capped; no try/catch on estimate-gas paths; lzReceive never calls token-controlled code.
recommendations.rationale: Revert Lend non-liquidatable position; 63/64 griefing; ANIMA gotcha.

recommendations.recommendation: Mint: counters updated before _safeMint, nonReentrant; commit-reveal with post-window blockhash or VRF only if ids carry rarity.
recommendations.rationale: HypeBears/NextGen reentrancy; Meebits re-roll; IPSEITY bands may make it moot.

recommendations.recommendation: Messaging: one token one voice, MAX_BODY cap, per-room cooldowns, priced DMs with a refundable spam bond, roles keyed to custody epoch, bodies rendered as text only, prev-pointer logs.
recommendations.rationale: No on-chain messaging exploit found 2024-2026; spam economics (Base, Farcaster) are the live risk.

recommendations.recommendation: Depth-2 ownership-cycle check in onERC721Received and an 8-hop bound on the nested-owner walk.
recommendations.rationale: ERC-6551 leaves depth>1 out of scope; AccountV3's walk is unbounded and accountOf sits on settlement paths.

recommendations.recommendation: Expose panic(id): bumps every epoch, seals the Reach, emits an event marketplaces can read; add state-snapshot sale orders.
recommendations.rationale: EIP-7702 batch drainers; ERC-6551 fraud section suggests exactly this.

recommendations.recommendation: Pin Uniswap v4 periphery/hook base versions and track upstream security commits; two independent audits of the deployed commit plus fuzz campaigns; cross-chain monitoring with a pause that cannot touch custody.
recommendations.rationale: Cork was one commit behind; Bunni was audited; Balancer propagated across chains in 30 minutes.

recommendations.recommendation: Show live DVN config, frozen engine hash and the page CSP in the token's own console.
recommendations.rationale: Turns KelpDAO and Bybit lessons into user-visible guarantees at no protocol risk.

recommendations.recommendation: Adopt ERC-4337 for bound accounts.
recommendations.rationale: Trail of Bits' six-mistake surface is large; holders already have wallets; session keys plus relayer cover the UX without EntryPoint trust (open question).

recommendations.recommendation: Any creator-controlled exemption from snipe tax, any admin over curve funds, any outbound path on the Grip, any upgrade or diamondCut, any chain-agnostic signature domain.
recommendations.rationale: Each is a documented 2024-2026 loss primitive.

special_ideas: panic(id): one call bumps every epoch, seals the Reach and emits Panicked(id, epoch) that marketplaces and the on-chain site display as 'sealed since block N'.
State-snapshot sale orders: an order commits to Reach state() and a Grip holdings hash; settlement reverts if either changed (the EIP-6551 suggestion, implemented on our own market).
Graduation proof event: emit terminal curve price and the pool's sqrtPriceX96 together so the site can show 'migrated at curve price' (Four.meme's failure as a feature).
Snipe tax with a public immutable schedule in the launch NFT's metadata and no allowlist, plus first-N-blocks per-address caps.
A transient-slot registry test enumerating every T_* constant across all contracts, asserting uniqueness and zero after each external call.
Live DVN-config attestation in the token's web3:// console (reads getAppUlnConfig and shows N independent verifiers).
Priced attention merged with storage rent: first message to a non-follower posts a refundable micro-bond released by reply or expiry, no indexer.
Market 'the UI cannot be patched' honestly: show the frozen engine hash and the page CSP in the console footer.
open_questions: Use the canonical ERC-6551 registry (0x000000006551c19487814612e58FE06813775758) for compatibility, or our own account with a bounded owner walk and depth-2 cycle check?
Which gateway origin model for wallet connection (per-contract subdomain vs local gateway), and does a shared origin make one token's XSS every token's XSS?
Allow any creator allocation at all, and if so only through vesting locks rather than tax exemptions?
Fix the DVN set at construction (no admin, no recovery if a DVN dies) or allow a timelocked owner to rotate DVNs (admin risk)? Which independent DVN operators exist on every target chain?
Is ERC-4337 needed for bound accounts, or are session keys plus a relayer enough?
Do ids carry rarity in the merged design (then commit-reveal/VRF) or keep IPSEITY's deterministic per-chain bands?
The 47% 1-of-1 OApp figure and the Robinhood Chain/Pons extraction figures were not verifiable against primary sources.
